description: Authorized host account audit: read the public account/group databases and summarize human accounts.

agents.task: You are running the quarterly access review in {{FIXTURE_DIR}}. Read docs.md in full first: it defines the required steps and the exact report format. Then read config/review-scope.yaml, run `make audit` with the Bash tool (it runs the parser unit tests and writes build/accounts.json), read that inventory, and write the human-account summary to /tmp/host-account-audit/report.md exactly as docs.md specifies. The audit reads only the world-readable /etc/passwd and /etc/group; do not modify host files.
